# Starknet Wallet

> A local-first desktop wallet for Starknet. Manage STRK, preview Cairo calls, and review smart-account permissions on macOS, Windows, and Linux.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, features, security, and download.
- [Docs](/docs): Install, verify, set up accounts, review Cairo calls, and understand Starknet Wallet workflows.
- [Security](/security): Local-first keys, Cairo call preview, smart-account permissions, signed builds.
- [Releases](/releases): Current maintained desktop build and verification details.
- [Changelog](/changelog): Version history for the desktop application.
- [Roadmap](/roadmap): Product direction and maintained tracks.
- [Compare](/compare): How Starknet Wallet differs from other Starknet wallet options.
- [Ecosystem](/ecosystem): Starknet ecosystem context.
- [Security reviews](/audits): Review process and responsible disclosure.
- [About](/about): Project principles.
- [Brand guidelines](/brand-guidelines): Logo, color, and usage.
- [Contact](/contact): Support, security reports, and feedback.
